The Yamamoto-first pass checked current ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, Space M&A and Japanese jazz sources and found no new unrecorded verified Tsuyoshi Yamamoto date. Robert Glasper X Questlove + Special Guest Bilal clears RADAR admission because the specific one-night lineup concentrates three connected but distinct languages—Glasper's jazz/R&B/hip-hop keyboard vocabulary, Questlove's live hip-hop drum architecture, and Bilal's free-form instrumental vocal approach—inside Blue Note's intimate Robtober setting. A+ captures the recommendation: it is unusually strong and worth actively making room for, while the collaborators' long shared musical lineage and the broader month-long Robtober residency do not require S-level scarcity. Recent/current RADAR additions are again dominated by A and A+, so this batch does not expand the scarcity tiers.

en.why_it_matters: The appeal is the rhythmic and vocal conversation, not celebrity stacking. Glasper's harmonic language has spent years dissolving the line between jazz, hip-hop and R&B; Questlove brings a drummer's sense of pocket that helped make live-band hip-hop its own grammar; Bilal can move between song and improvising instrument. In a Blue Note room small enough for those micro-decisions to register, the lineup has a concrete musical reason to exist.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two sets if New York is already in the corridor. It is strong enough to build that evening around, especially for groove, drums and the jazz-to-soul continuum, but I would not reorganize a larger regional trip solely around this one Robtober night.

es.why_it_matters: Lo chingón aquí no es amontonar nombres, sino la conversación entre ritmo y voz. El lenguaje armónico de Glasper lleva años borrando la frontera entre jazz, hip-hop y R&B; Questlove trae un sentido del pocket que ayudó a convertir el hip-hop tocado por una banda en una gramática propia; y Bilal puede pasar de canción a instrumento improvisador sin avisar. En una sala tan pequeña como Blue Note, esas microdecisiones sí se escuchan y le dan una razón musical concreta a la alineación.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets si Nueva York ya está dentro del corredor del viaje. Tiene suficiente peso para construir esa noche alrededor del show, sobre todo si groove, batería y el continuo jazz-soul están en el hilo, pero no reorganizaría un viaje regional completo únicamente por esta fecha de Robtober.
